ab.note: Is this correctly transcribed "circumcisio", or should be transcribed "circumsio"?
It appears that the hand responsible for rubrication corrected the final "e" to "ae".
The tachygraphy employed in the text typically represents "sed"; does it ever abbreviate "si"?

There is a small diagonal stroke below the "e" that could indicate that the scribe was writing "aerunt", but this spelling is unattested in the other Latin manuscripts I have transcribed in Ephesians.
